name: D-CoT-Benchmarks
description: A benchmark suite designed to evaluate Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and deliberative prompting methods for language models across diverse reasoning tasks. It aggregates tasks and evaluation scripts to measure whether D-CoT-style approaches improve answer accuracy and reasoning quality. Intended for systematic comparison of prompting strategies and reasoning capabilities.
reputation: An emerging research benchmark used to assess and compare chain-of-thought prompting techniques; known within the LLM reasoning community.
